subject: feature request: as.quoted to handle factors

messages.author: 0257010a9dc8ccab
messages.subject: feature request: as.quoted to handle factors
parts:
Hi,

Would it be possible to extend as.quoted to handle factors? Maybe
have as.quoted try to apply as.character to the input before failing?

Thanks!
Matt

> as.quoted(c("a", "b", "c"))
List of 3
$ a: symbol a
$ b: symbol b
$ c: symbol c
- attr(*, "class")= chr "quoted"

> as.quoted(as.factor(c("a","b","c")))
Error in UseMethod("as.quoted") :
no applicable method for 'as.quoted' applied to an object of class "factor"

> as.quoted(as.character(as.factor(c("a","b","c"))))
List of 3
$ a: symbol a
$ b: symbol b
$ c: symbol c
- attr(*, "class")= chr "quoted"

messages.subject: Re: feature request: as.quoted to handle factors
parts:
Hi Hadley,

Here is an example:

library(plyr)
df <- data.frame( name=c("abc","efg") )
the_columns <- data.frame( col=c("name") )

class(the_columns$col)

print("works")
d_ply(df, as.character(the_columns$col), function(d){print(d)})

print("does not work")
d_ply(df, the_columns$col, function(d){print(d)})


Best,
Matt
